title: Snowflake connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Snowflake connector instance's settings: the account, warehouse, database and schema, the projecting SELECT the source runs, the ingest target the sink bulk-loads into, and the driver path. The driver is native code in the Loams process, so it loads by path from the namespace's allowlist with a SHA-256 check (CN1 Ruling 9, Q349). `password` and `token` resolve through the namespace's secret store (D189) and are exactly the manifest's `secrets` list.

password.description: The user's password, when authenticating by password. Resolved through the secret store (D189); the rendered driver options read it from a mounted file.

authenticator.description: How the driver authenticates; the manifest's auth slugs key, oauth2 and basic (§33 Appendix A.4).

private_key_pem.description: The key-pair private key, as PEM, when authenticating by KEY_PAIR_JWT. Resolved through the secret store (D189).

private_key_passphrase.description: The passphrase protecting `private_key_pem`, when it has one. Resolved through the secret store (D189).

token.description: An OAuth2 access token, when authenticating by OAUTH. Resolved through the secret store (D189).

warehouse.description: The warehouse the source's query runs on and the sink loads into.

query.description: A projecting SELECT for the source, when the route does not name one.

partitions.description: Partitions the source splits the read across, using ExecutePartitions where the driver supports it (CN1 Task 11: Snowflake does, verify).

target_table.description: The sink's bulk-ingest target table (adbc.ingest.target_table, CN1 Task 11).

mode.description: The sink's ingest mode (CN1 Task 11: bulk_ingest append or create_append).

partition_by.description: The declared key the bulk path partitions by (D356).

driver.description: The ADBC driver to load, by its allowlist name from the namespace config (CN1 Ruling 9); only from /opt/loams/adbc/<name>/<version>/ with a SHA-256 check.

driver_version.description: The pinned driver build to load out of /opt/loams/adbc/snowflake/<version>/.
